Hi Sam / Priya,

Following up on last week's introductory call — thanks again for connecting. We want to lock down the procurement and co-sell intake steps so Helio's listing can move through validation without surprises. High-level asks:

- Confirm required procurement docs and the expected review timeline from your side.
- Clarify billing SKU & pricing guidance (is metered billing supported for our consumption pattern?).
- Confirm the co-sell nomination flow and whether we need an additional partner profile / POA.

Attached is our draft intake spreadsheet (redwood_gcp_intake_v1.xlsx) and an internal procurement checklist. Can you review and flag any missing items? Also propose a 30-minute slot for a short alignment session this week.

Thanks — Hannah

Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing — onboarding procurement map & intake

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick responses inline: 

- Required docs: reseller agreement (if co-sell), vendor W-9 / tax form, SOC 2 report (or equivalent security attestation), and the product manifest. The partner intake form will capture most of these; if something is missing we'll flag it.
- Timeline: typical intake to listing validation is 3–5 weeks assuming docs move promptly. Procurement review (billing/SKUs) happens during weeks 2–3.
- Billing: GCP supports metered billing for marketplace listings; we'll need the SKU design and pricing tiers. If you prefer committed usage instead, that's a separate path that adds a procurement review step.
- Co-sell nomination: yes — please provide the partner contact and the sales lead who will own nominations. We'll open a co-sell case once the listing is in validation.

I attached the partner intake URL here: https://partnerdash.google.com/forms/marketplace-intake — Priya, please start the intake and ping me when it's submitted.

Sam Tan
Partner Ops, Google Cloud

Sam / team — a few procurement constraints from our side that will affect the timeline: 

- We need to present the SKU and pricing model to our Finance and Legal teams for pre-approval before final submission to GCP. That adds ~5 business days.
- For Helio's use-case, we expect variable-monthly spend; metered billing is preferable but we need confirmation on billing granularity (per-second vs per-minute token pricing).
- Any additional Marketplace fees or revenue share percentages need to be documented up front; our procurement owner will not accept unknown percentages at sign-off.

Action items for Redwood: finalize SKU naming, provide a sample invoice flow.
Action items for Helio: complete intake form and confirm preferred pricing cadence.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
